summary: Turn climate commitments into policy matrices, indicators, and reporting evidence. Explore the five-day intermediate course and plan your training.
lede: Climate policy and international agreements connect shared commitments with practical measures, assigned responsibilities, and evidence of progress. For climate-policy officers, adaptation planners, and climate-finance analysts, the course develops skills in mapping commitments to policy measures, building responsibility matrices, and selecting indicators and reporting evidence to monitor implementation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who turn climate commitments into sector plans, implementation responsibilities, finance priorities, and reporting evidence. It suits an intermediate level and connects policy design with the practical work of coordination and monitoring.
modules: Multilateral Climate Commitments and Policy Mandates
Global Stocktake and Policy Gap Analysis
IPCC Evidence and Emissions Policy Baselines
prerequisites: Working familiarity with public policy, climate action planning, environmental reporting, or climate-finance processes. Coding or programming is not required.
